jobs.title: Senior Security Officer
jobs.description:
Thales Norway utvikler og leverer verdensledende program- og maskinvareløsninger for kryptografi og sikker kommunikasjon, samt teknologi som understøtter NATO og NATO-nasjoners kritiske infrastruktur for kommunikasjon. Vi står foran en spennende utvikling i selskapet. Thales Norway skal sammen med Kongsberg Defence Communication AS, som er en del av Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, etablere et nytt joint venture – Kongsberg Thales Defence Communication AS (KTDC). Det nye selskapet vil være eid 50/50 av KONGSBERG og THALES og vil samle sterke fagmiljøer innen sikre kommunikasjons- og cybersikkerhetsløsninger.

Vi søker en erfaren og engasjert fagperson til rollen som Senior Security Officer, som vil få en sentral rolle i sikkerhetsarbeidet i selskapet. Du vil fungere som nestkommanderende i sikkerhetsavdelingen og være en viktig støttespiller for Head of Security i arbeidet med å sikre helhetlig og effektiv sikkerhetsstyring. Stillingen innebærer også et særlig ansvar for å følge opp sikkerhetsarbeidet ved vår virksomhet i Asker.

Rollen er organisatorisk plassert i sikkerhetsavdelingen og rapporterer til Head of Security. Du vil samarbeide tett med sikkerhetsmiljøet i Oslo og øvrige fagmiljøer i organisasjonen. Som stedfortreder for Head of Security vil du ha ansvar innenfor fastsatte fullmakter, herunder myndighetskontakt og rapportering til ledelsen. Du vil også inngå i selskapets kriseorganisasjon som assisterende kriseleder, og ivareta kriselederfunksjonen ved kriseleders fravær.

Arbeidsoppgaver og ansvarsområder

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle selskapets styringssystem for sikkerhet (ISMS), herunder styrende dokumentasjon og kravregister.

  • Gjennomføre samsvarsvurderinger mot relevante sikkerhetskrav, internkontroll og oppfølging av avvik og korrigerende tiltak til lukking.

  • Utarbeide Statement of Applicability (SoA), sikkerhetsrapportering, KPI-er og beslutningsgrunnlag til ledelsens gjennomgang og årlig evaluering av sikkerhetstilstanden.

  • Koordinere tilsyn, revisjoner og NATO-inspeksjoner, samt bidra til sikkerhetsopplæring og bevisstgjøring i organisasjonen.

  • Følge opp at virksomheten har godkjent teknisk sikkerhetsundersøkelse (TSU) der dette kreves.

  • Følge opp fysisk sikkerhet i Asker, herunder sikkerhetssoner, adgangskontroll, alarmsystemer, nøkkelhåndtering, besøkende og leverandører med fysisk tilgang.

  • Være lokalt kontaktpunkt for sikkerhetsspørsmål, håndtere og eskalere sikkerhetshendelser og avvik, samt bidra ved lokal hendelseshåndtering.

  • Utarbeide og følge opp lokale sikkerhetsrutiner, beredskapsplaner og øvelser, samt bistå innen personellsikkerhet, arkiv og øvrige sikkerhetsrelaterte oppgaver.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper

  • Minimum fem års relevant erfaring fra sikkerhetsarbeid, gjerne innen sikkerhetsstyring, informasjonssikkerhet, fysisk sikkerhet eller tilsvarende.

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå. Dokumentert erfaring og gode resultater kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning.

  • Erfaring med sikkerhetsstyringssystemer, internkontroll, samsvarsvurderinger og risikostyring.

  • God forståelse for sikkerhetskrav og evne til å omsette regelverk og styrende dokumentasjon til praktiske og etterlevbare løsninger.

  • Kjennskap til sikkerhetsloven med forskrifter, NATO-relaterte sikkerhetskrav og ISO/IEC 27001 er en fordel.

  • Erfaring fra forsvarssektoren, virksomhet underlagt sikkerhetsloven eller annen sikkerhetskritisk virksomhet er ønskelig.

  • Erfaring med fysisk sikring, beredskap eller krisehåndtering er en fordel.

  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Strukturert, selvstendig og løsningsorientert, med høy integritet, god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å opptre rolig og handlekraftig ved hendelser.

  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å skape tillit og gjennomslag på tvers av organisasjonen.

Arbeidssted er Asker, men du vil være minst én dag i uken på kontoret vårt i Oslo. Dette sørger for et jevnlig og tett samarbeid med sikkerhetsavdelingen på hovedkotoret. Stillingen innebærer lokale kontrollrunder og begrenset reisevirksomhet, normalt inntil 5 % årlig. Ved sikkerhetshendelser kan det etter nærmere avtale være behov for tilgjengelighet utenom ordinær arbeidstid.

For søkere med mindre enn 10 års arbeidserfaring ønsker vi at vitnemål og karakterutskrift legges ved søknaden.

For å være en aktuell kandidat til stillingen, må du være norsk statsborger, og du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres for nivå STRENGT HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET med særinstrukser fra Nasjonal Sikkerhetsmyndighet. Du kan ikke inneha annet statsborgerskap enn norsk.  

Thales Norway tilbyr

  • En sentral rolle i et selskap med høyteknologiske produkter og løsninger

  • Muligheten til å påvirke og videreutvikle arbeidet med informasjonssystemsikkerhet i Thales Norway

  • Faglig utvikling i et sterkt og kompetent sikkerhetsmiljø

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med høy trivsel, stor takhøyde og hyggelige kollegaer

  • Gode muligheter for kompetanseutvikling og faglig fordypning

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninge

  • Sosiale aktiviteter gjennom året

  • Moderne lokaler i Asker Panorama

Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Sesonghjelp
jobs.description:
Har du interesse for klær og mote, og vil jobbe hos VIC Kongsberg i julesesongen?

Til arbeid ved behov som Butikkselger i julesesongen (november, desember, januar), er vi på jakt etter deg som ønsker å møte kunden med et smil og sørge for en kundeopplevelse utenom det vanlige.

I våre butikker er service og produktkompetanse i fokus når vi møter kunden

Vi ser for oss at du trives med å jobbe med mennesker, salg og service, og drives av å jobbe mot felles mål. Du er imøtekommende av natur, sosial og har en stor interesse for mote og trender.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har fullført og bestått videregående skole, relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende utdannelse

  • Har salgserfaring fra tilsvarende bransje, gjerne varehandel

Vi tilbyr:

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med kvalitetsprodukter i et dynamisk selskap som leverer solide resultater og er i stor vekst

  • Karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter står i fokus hos VOICE, og vi har gode læringsplattformer

  • En jobb i et selskap der bærekraft er en integrert del av vår forretningsstrategi

  • Tett oppfølging og support

Stillingen krever at man er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid.

Mangfold er en styrke, og vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike livserfaringer og perspektiver. Vi oppfordrer alle kandidater med oppgitte kvalifikasjoner til å søke.

Søkere behandles og intervjuer avholdes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

VIC er en norsk kleskjede for kvinner og menn. Hos oss lever signaturplagg og trendprodukter side om side. Den perfekte garderobe består av et knippe hverdagsfavoritter og selskapsgleder du kan mikse og trikse i utallige kombinasjoner. Vi ønsker å bidra med plagg som skaper gode minner, og kan bli med deg livet ut. Akkurat som en trofast venn.

I VIC designer, produserer og selger vi våre egne merkevarer BLU, Mellowfield og Vesbar. Dette er tre merker vi er veldig stolte over og som kundene våre elsker. I tillegg selger vi merkevarene Jean Paul, MAC, Donna, Mario Conti, Mr Capuchin, Calvin Klein og Riccovero.

Med 45 butikker over hele Norge og en klar strategi om å fortsette vokse, er VIC en kjede med ambisjoner og hvor det er mye spennende som skjer hele tiden. Vi har mange engasjerte og dyktige medarbeidere som gleder seg til å hjelpe deg når du kommer til oss. Vi jobber daglig for å gi deg en god handleopplevelse uansett om du besøker oss i butikk, på nett eller i Sosiale Media.

Som organisasjon er vi opptatt av medarbeiderne våre og har tett dialog mellom servicekontor og hver enkelt butikk. Vi skal spille hverandre gode for å bidra til at hver enkelt medarbeider lykkes i sin rolle.

jobs.title: Ventilasjonsmontør

jobs.description:
GK er en Skandinavisk teknisk entreprenør og servicepartner, og fagarbeiderne er kjernen i virksomheten vår.

Vi søker nå en ventilasjonsmontør som kan autoriseres for arbeid i forsvarsbygg. Du vil jobbe med ventilasjonsmontasje både i forsvarsbygg og i alle andre typer bygg, og får en variert arbeidshverdag med ulike oppdrag.

Vi ser etter deg som har erfaring med ventilasjonsmontasje. Det viktigste er at du trives med selvstendig arbeid, tar ansvar og finner gode løsninger i hverdagen.

  • har førerkort klasse B

Søknadsfrist er 29. november, og arbeidssted er Oslo. Vi behandler søknader etter søknadsfrist. Vi har gjort søknadsprosessen enkel, så det eneste du trenger å gjøre er å svare på noen korte spørsmål og laste opp CV-en din.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

GK er en ledende teknisk entreprenør og servicepartner. Vi leverer tekniske installasjoner og rådgivning som gir dokumenterte energi- og miljøgevinster, samtidig som vi sikrer god komfort for byggets brukere – gjennom hele byggets livsløp.

Vår misjon er å bygge bærekraftige samfunn for generasjoner. Les mer om GK her.

jobs.title: Er du en butikksjef som setter folk først? Kom til Brilleland – Vi ses!
jobs.description:
Kom og gjør en forskjell sammen med oss. Som butikksjef hos oss blir du nøkkelpersonen for både kunder og ansatte. Du får ansvar og muligheten til å skape et varmt og profesjonelt butikkmiljø, hvor alle føler seg ivaretatt. Sammen gir vi folk trygghet for syn og øyehelse.

MULIGHETER

I Brilleland er du en del av et arbeidsmiljø som ønsker å gi deg muligheter. God utvikling av deg som leder, spennende karrieremuligheter og et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø er blant våre viktigste prioriteter! Vi elsker at du sammen med oss setter mål for din egen utvikling og samtidig bidrar til at dine medarbeidere får god opplæring og utvikling av sin kompetanse i et trygt og inspirerende arbeidsmiljø. Du vil innse at vi stadig lærer noe nytt og sjelden blir utlært i vår bransje.

ANSVAR I STILLINGEN

Som butikksjef har du hovedansvar for butikkens resultater, daglig salgsoppfølging og budsjett, personalledelse og utvikling av teamet, samt effektiv og trygg butikkdrift med høy kundetilfredshet. Du leder gjennom tilstedeværelse og er en aktiv del av butikkhverdagen, med arbeidstid tilpasset butikkens åpningstider gjennom en variert turnus. Norsk er hovedspråket i butikken og i kundemøtene, så du må beherske norsk flytende. I tillegg må du kunne forstå og bruke engelsk godt nok til å følge interne kurs og webinarer, siden en økende del av vår opplæring foregår på engelsk.

STØTTE I HVERDAGEN

Salgssjefen din er til enhver tid er en støtte for deg og din butikk, og du har et servicekontor som står på for at det skal være lettere for deg å utføre jobben din. Vi har i tillegg et unikt og godt samarbeide på tvers av butikkene.

LITT KONKURRANSE ER SUNT

Vi ønsker en butikksjef med nok konkurranseinstinkt og driv til å stadig ønske forbedring. Gjennom lederen i deg forstår du hvordan økonomi, detaljhandel og profesjonell kundeservice fungerer. En god butikksjef skal motivere sine ansatte i travle så vel som rolige dager.

Vi verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av alder, kjønn, etnisitet, nasjonalitet, religion, seksuell orientering eller funksjonsnedsettelse.

Takk for at du vurderer å bli en del av Brilleland. Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å sende inn søknad om du kjenner deg igjen i stillingen! Vi ses!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I over 40 år har Brilleland gjort god synshjelp tilgjengelig for alle. I dag er vi en av Norges ledende optikerkjeder, med over 70 butikker og medarbeidere over hele landet som hver dag hjelper mennesker til bedre syn, god øyehelse og økt livskvalitet.

Hos Brilleland kombinerer vi høy fagkompetanse, moderne løsninger og et bredt utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til konkurransedyktige priser. Vårt mål er enkelt: Alle skal oppleve at de har råd til god synskomfort og profesjonell oppfølging, enten de trenger briller, solbriller, kontaktlinser eller synsundersøkelser.

Vi er opptatt av å skape et arbeidsmiljø der mennesker trives, utvikler seg og lykkes sammen. Derfor investerer vi i faglig utvikling, karrieremuligheter og et sterkt kollegialt fellesskap på tvers av butikker og fagområder.

Brilleland er en del av Synoptik Norge og EssilorLuxottica, verdens ledende aktør innen synsløsninger, briller og solbriller. Det gir oss tilgang til internasjonal kompetanse, innovasjon og utviklingsmuligheter, samtidig som vi beholder vår sterke lokale forankring og nærheten til kundene våre.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Operatori/Operatrici camera sterile---Operatori/Operatrici camera sterile=================================== **Descrizione dell'azienda**Flexsis ti accompagna come specialista o lavoratore nei settori dell'industria, dell'edilizia, della produzione, della logistica, della tecnica o dei servizi. Ti proponiamo incarichi in linea con il tuo profilo e i tuoi obiettivi.Con oltre 50 filiali in tutta la Svizzera, ti offriamo l'accesso a un'ampia rete. Puoi contare su un interlocutore personale che ti accompagna in ogni fase.Da noi sei pienamente coperto secondo il CCL Prestito di personale, approfitti di interessanti offerte di formazione continua e collabori con un fornitore di servizi HR certificato ISO 9001\. **Descrizione della posizione**Per solida realtà operante nel settore farmaceutico, con sede a Lugano, selezioniamo **OPERATORI/OPERATRICI DI CAMERA STERILE.**Gli operatori e operatrici di camera sterile dovranno occuparsi di:* Gestire e monitorare le camere sterili durante i processi di produzione, assicurando il mantenimento degli ambienti controllati;* Eseguire operazioni di **preparazione** e **confezionamento** di dispositivi medici, farmaci o altri prodotti sterili;* Controllare l'efficacia della **sterilizzazione** e la qualità dei materiali utilizzati;* Rispettare e applicare le **procedure di sicurezza**, garantendo che tutti i processi rispettino gli **standard** di igiene e qualità;* Registrare i dati relativi alle operazioni svolte, segnalando eventuali anomalie o non conformità. **Profilo ricercato**Requisiti:*  **Esperienza pregressa** come operatore in camera sterile o in ambienti di produzione farmaceutica o biomedicale;* Conoscenza delle normative di sterilizzazione;* Conoscenza delle **norme GMP**;*  **Precisione**, **velocità** nell'esecuzione ed **attenzione** ai dettagli;* Disponibilità a lavorare su 3 turni;* Possesso della **patente** di guida **B** e dell'auto.La nostra offertaSi offre contratto a tempo indeterminato con agenzia con possibilità di assunzione diretta da parte dell'azienda.******jid6965b2bjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: (Exklusiv) Senior Pflegeexperte - Fachentwicklung, Schulung, QM / Fest---(Exklusiv) Senior Pflegeexperte \- Fachentwicklung, Schulung, QM / Fest=======================================================================### EinleitungIm direkten Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einer sympathischen, renommierten und stark wachsenden Spitex\-Organisation (PA\-Modell) mit sympathischer Firmenkultur, suchen wir für den Ausbau des Teams in Zürich (zentrale , Parkplätze vorhanden) eine erfahrene Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/BSc Pflege als Sr. Pflegeexperte/in (80\-100%).### der ArbeitIn dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion gestalten Sie die fachliche Entwicklung der Organisation aktiv mit. Sie konzipieren, organisieren und leiten interne Fachschulungen, Workshops und Weiterbildungen für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen und entwickeln praxisnahe Schulungskonzepte zu Themen wie InterRAI\-HC, Pflegeplanung, Pflegedokumentation sowie KLV\- und WZW\-Kriterien. Als kompetente Fachperson begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende im Rahmen von Coachings, Fallbesprechungen und Praxisbegleitungen und unterstützen bei komplexen Pflegesituationen (ohne eigene Pflegetätigkeit). Zudem wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung von Schulungsunterlagen, Praxisleitfäden und pflegerischen Standards mit. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt im Qualitätsmanagement und Pflegecontrolling. Sie analysieren Pflegedossiers, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und stellen eine fachgerechte Bedarfsabklärung, Pflegeplanung und Dokumentation sicher. Gemeinsam mit der Pflegedienstleitung und weiteren Fachstellen fördern Sie eine einheitliche, evidenzbasierte Pflegepraxis und unterstützen die Umsetzung von Qualitätsmassnahmen sowie internen Audits.  Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Fachfunktion mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum zu übernehmen und den Aufbau eines nachhaltigen Schulungs\- und Fachentwicklungskonzeptes aktiv mitzugestalten. Sie dürfen sich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, moderne Strukturen, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen sowie langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb einer erfolgreichen und wachsenden Organisation freuen.### AnforderungsprofilFür diese spannende Herausforderung verfügen Sie über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (BSc Pflege etc.). Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der ambulanten Pflege, idealerweise im Spitex\-Umfeld (ev. mit PA\-Modell), mit und verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in InterRAI\-HC, Pflegeplanung, Pflegedokumentation sowie den gesetzlichen Anforderungen im Bereich KLV und WZW. Idealerweise konnten Sie zudem bereits Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung, Fachentwicklung oder der Durchführung von Schulungen sammeln. Eine pädagogische Weiterbildung (z.B. SVEB, Berufsbildner/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation) ist von Vorteil. Sie überzeugen durch Ihre ausgeprägten didaktischen, organisatorischen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und verstehen es, Mitarbeitende zu fördern sowie nachhaltige Verbesserungen anzustossen.  Sind Sie auf der Suche nach einer vielseitigen Pflegeexperten\-Funktion in der Fachentwicklung, Schulung sowie QM mit viel Gestaltungsfreiheit und Entwicklungspotenzial? jobs.title: Peer Mitarbeiterin / Peer Mitarbeiter
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Mitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX-IN)---Mitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX\-IN)====================================Die Clienia\-Gruppe gehört zu den grössten privaten Anbieterinnen psychiatrischer Dienstleistungen in der Schweiz. Mit über 20 Standorten – darunter die Privatkliniken Clienia Littenheid und Clienia Schlössli sowie das gerontopsychiatrische Angebot der Clienia Bergheim – bietet sie ein vielfältiges Spektrum an psychiatrischen und psychotherapeutischen Behandlungsmethoden im ambulanten, tagesklinischen und stationären Rahmen an. Die Gruppe beschäftigt rund 1800 Mitarbeitende und erzielte 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 240 .  Für unsere zertifizierte Station A2 für Stressfolgeerkrankungen und Emotionsregulation mit Behandlungsschwerpunkt DBT suchen wir per 1\. März 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/nMitarbeiterin / Mitarbeiter (EX\-IN)====================================20%===Station A2 für Psychotherapie mit Behandlungsschwerpunkt Emotionsregulation (DBT)Die Station A2 ist spezialisiert auf Stressfolgeerkrankungen. Ziel der Behandlung ist eine funktionale Emotionsregulation, damit die Patienten ihre vielfältigen Symptome wie Selbstverletzungen, impulsives Verhalten sowie emotionale Instabilität reduzieren können. Die Behandlung richtet sich ganz nach dem Konzept der DBT (Dialektisch Behaviorale Therapie, nach M. Linehan), umfasst aber auch Interventionen der Schematherapie, Ergo\- und Bewegungstherapie, neuropsychologisches Training sowie komplementärmedizinische Angebote wie Phytotherapie, Akupunktur und Aromapflege.  Die Atmosphäre auf der Station wird durch eine respektvolle Grundhaltung und der sorgfältigen Pflege zwischenmenschlicher Beziehungen geprägt.### Ihre Aufgaben* Begleitung von Patienten auf ihrem Genesungsweg im Rahmen von Einzelgesprächen und im Stationsalltag  * Einbringen der Perspektive von Erfahrung mit psychischer Erkrankung und Genesung in behandlungsrelevante Bereiche  * Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kernteam  * Durchführung eines peergeleiteten Gruppenangebotes zur Unterstützung des persönlichen Recover\-Prozesses der Betroffenen  * Unterstützung und Vernetzung zu Nachsorge\-Angeboten, z.B. Selbsthilfegruppen  * Teilnahme an Intervisionen sowie an der Fachgruppe und Recovery  ### Ihr Profil* Du bringst eine hohe fachliche und persönliche Kompetenz als Expertin oder Experte aus Erfahrung mit und warst idealerweise bereits als im stationären Setting tätig  * Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene \-Weiterbildung (EX\-IN)  * Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, eine Weiterbildung in DBT (Dialektisch Behaviorale Therapie, nach M. Linehan) zu absolvieren  * Du hast ein erweitertes Verständnis der eigenen Genesungsgeschichte und kannst differenziert darüber sprechen  * Du kannst Übersetzer/\-in und Vermittler/\-in für die Patienten (z.B. Beantwortung von Fragen zu Krankheitsbildern) sein  * Du kannst empathisch und unvoreingenommen auf andere Menschen zugehen  * Du verfügst über eine hohe Teamfähigkeit  * Du verfügst über die Fähigkeit zu selbst organisiertem, eigenständigem Arbeiten  ### Unser AngebotNebst einem spannenden Arbeitsbereich bieten wir dir eine gute Einführung auf der Station, ein vielseitiges Weiterbildungsangebot sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen in einer modernen Klinik.Fühlst du dich angesprochen?  Weitere Auskünfte erteilt dir gerne Leyendecker, Stationsleiterin, Tel. oder , Bereichsleiterin Pflege, Tel. .  Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung via Bewerbungstool.### Arbeitsort **Clienia Schlössli AG  Privatklinik für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie**  Schlösslistrasse 8  CH\-8618 Oetwil am See  Tel.  ### Ihre Kontaktperson  Bereichsleiterin Pflege  Tel.******jidc2fe1cajm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: (Exklusiv) Manager Klientenbetreuung Spitex 80-100% / Fest---(Exklusiv) Manager Klientenbetreuung Spitex 80\-100% / Fest===========================================================### EinleitungIm exklusiven Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einer renommierten und stark wachsenden Spitex\-Organisation mit einer sympathischen Firmenkultur und einem innovativen Betreuungsmodell für pflegende Angehörige, suchen wir zur Verstärkung des Teams eine erfahrene, kommunikative und dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit für die anspruchsvolle Kundenbetreuung.### der ArbeitIn dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion sind Sie die zentrale Ansprechperson für Klienten und deren Angehörige bei anspruchsvollen Anliegen und individuellen Fragestellungen. Sie beraten und begleiten die Klienten rund um die angebotenen Spitex\-Dienstleistungen und erarbeiten gemeinsam mit den involvierten Stellen kundenorientierte Lösungen. Dabei stehen Sie in engem Austausch mit den Pflegefachpersonen, internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Ansprechpartnern und sorgen für eine professionelle und verbindliche Kommunikation. Darüber hinaus erkennen Sie Optimierungspotenziale und wirken bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Abläufe und Qualitätsstandards mit. Mit Ihrem ausgeprägten Dienstleistungsverständnis leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Klientenzufriedenheit und Betreuungsqualität.  Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen eine abwechslungsreiche, sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Unternehmen. Sie profitieren von einer kollegialen Unternehmenskultur, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen und langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.### AnforderungsprofilUm in dieser spannenden Funktion erfolgreich zu sein, verfügen Sie über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische, pflegerische oder vergleichbare Ausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Kundenservice, in der Kommunikation oder im Qualitätsmanagement. Zudem bringen Sie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der anspruchsvollen Kundenbetreuung oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit. Erfahrungen im Gesundheitswesen, insbesondere im Spitex\-Bereich, sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.  Sie haben Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, verfügen über ausgeprägtes Einfühlungsvermögen und verstehen es, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän und lösungsorientiert zu handeln. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Belastbarkeit sowie stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab. Bezeichnen Sie sich zudem als aufgestellte, kommunikative und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit einer gesunden Portion Humor? Dann sollten wir uns bald kennenlernen.  Möchten Sie Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr Organisationstalent in einem wachsenden Unternehmen einbringen? Schätzen Sie den persönlichen Kontakt mit Menschen und die Möglichkeit, mit Ihrem Engagement und Ihren Ideen etwas zu bewegen? jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Planification et Conduite des chantiers (H/F) --- Responsable Planification et Conduite des chantiers (H/F) ========================================================= ### Introduction Scheuchzer SA est une entreprise de 540 employés spécialisée dans l'entretien mécanisé des voies de chemin de fer. Elle met, depuis 1917, ses services au profit des réseaux ferrés les plus exigeants en Suisse et en Europe. En réunissant au sein d'une même entreprise les différents aspects tels que la conception, la construction, la fabrication, l'exploitation et l'entretien des machines, Scheuchzer SA est parfaitement équipée pour répondre aux exigences de ses clients. Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous cherchons un (e): Responsable Planification et Conduite des chantiers (H/F) --------------------------------------------------------- ### Votre mission Au sein de notre centre de profit Travaux voie ferrée, vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités de planification, de préparation et de conduite des chantiers. jobs.title: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer--- Field Application Engineer==========================**Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.**Your responsibilities*** Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.* Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.* Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.* Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.* Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.* Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.* Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.* Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.**Who we are looking for*** Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.* Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.* Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).* Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills* Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on* Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset* Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time**What we offer*** Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide* Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!* Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.* Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.* Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!* Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.* Company restaurant and other benefits **If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways,** because all competencies are valued! **Have we sparked your interest?** We look forward to getting to know you!Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams.Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.  *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment*. *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Manufacturing Divisions and Company Entities. The Aerospace Group EMEA is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA, and its Motion, Power, and Sensing Division is a key service provider to PHEMEA.*![Meggitt SA]()* Meggitt SA  Route de Moncor 4  1752 \-sur\-Glâne*jidf5c729cjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Lead
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Cloud Operations Lead--- Cloud Operations Lead=====================Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a**Cloud Operations Lead (80\-100%)**to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.We are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.Tasks-----**Your Mission**As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform \& Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.**What You Own in the First 12 Months*** **Availability and customer satisfaction.** You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.* **ISO 27001 and audit readiness.** Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit\-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.* **Team depth.** No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.**Responsibilities*** **Operations and multi\-hypervisor environment:** Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi\-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.* **Networking, storage and datacenter:** Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.* **Monitoring, incident response and recovery:** Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.* **Service desk and customer support:** Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.* **Team leadership:** Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on\-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.* **Automation and process:** Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.* **Compliance and audit readiness:** Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev\- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.* **Budget, vendors and procurement:** Co\-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform \& Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.Requirements------------**Who You Are**We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.* You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.* You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.* You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.* You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.* You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.**Must Haves*** **Leadership:** 5\+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.* **VMware:** hands\-on experience in production. You have operated it yourself, not only overseen it.* **Infrastructure:** practical working knowledge of networking, storage and datacenter operations.*  **and English:** you communicate confidently in both, spoken and written.* **Work authorisation:** Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.**Nice to Haves*** **Networking at provider scale — a strong plus:** segmentation, routing, firewalling, load balancing and DNS.* Experience with other hypervisors alongside VMware, and with hypervisor migrations.* Hands\-on Infrastructure as Code, e.g. Terraform or Ansible.* Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.* Operating experience in a regulated environment: ISO 27001, ISAE or SOC 2\.* Running operations through a platform migration or a consolidation.Benefits--------**What Xelon Offers*** A leadership role with real ownership in a Swiss cloud provider, not a coordination layer.* A platform in transition, which means your operational decisions change something visible.* Office in Zug with a hybrid working model, 80 to 100 percent.* Direct collaboration with the Head of Platform \& Technology and cross\-functional teams.* A team small enough that you know what everyone is working on.* Competitive salary, modern tooling and a product\-driven environment with clarity and ownership.**Join Our Mission**Do you feel like you are the person that would complete our team? Are you ready for a new challenge? Then apply now. We look forward to hearing from you.The Xelon Team![Xelon AG]()* Xelon AG  Poststrasse 15  6300 Zug*jid168bd11jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager

In this role, you will be the key link between our customers and our technical teams, ensuring long\-term partnerships and outstanding customer satisfaction.At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. You are familiar with terms such as IaaS, PaaS, public and private cloud, VMs, backup, storage, containers and related topics.* **Drive \& Ownership:** You are a self\-starter who likes to take matters into your own hand, take responsibility, and persistently work toward results.* **Matching education:** Bachelor’s degree (or comparable) in Information Systems, Business, Marketing, or a related field.* **(Swiss) \& English:** You speak both and English fluently and you are able to communicate confidently and flawlessly in both – in spoken and in written form. Additionally, you are able to effortlessly follow a conversation in Swiss .* **Customer Focus:** You keep the customer's interests in sight at all times. Going the extra\-mile for your customers comes naturally to you.* **Collaborative Team Player:** You thrive in cross\-functional environments, working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes.* **CRM Pro:** You are experience in working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).* **Results orientated mindset:** Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.**Nice\-to\-haves*** **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** You are characterized by a self\-motivated drive to explore new opportunities, a willingness to take initiative as well as to seek and provide solutions and a strong commitment to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.*  **Management Ambition:** The ambition to develop into a sales management role is seen as a plus. If all goes according to plan, Xelon just might offer you that opportunity once the time is right.* **Swiss and other additional Languages:** Any language additional to the required ones is considered a plus; Swiss is an asset in this role.* **HubSpot**: Any previous hands\-on experience and/or certification for HubSpot is valuable for this role.* **AI\-mindset**: Curiosity and openness towards AI\-supported workflows, along with a solid understanding of current AI developments and tools, and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency and outcomes.* **A feel for processes:** You contribute ideas on how we can further optimize our sales and marketing processes.Benefits--------* **Rewarding compensation:** Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives tied to growth and sales success.* **Creative freedom:** The opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the growth of a well\-established tech scale\-up.* **Flexible working hours \& remote options:** Work when and where you are most productive.* **Innovative environment:** Experience the dynamics of a tech scale\-up with a strong existing customer base. Modern tools and technologies support your work.*  **, dynamic team:** Together we achieve our goals and celebrate our successes.**Join our mission**Do you feel like you are the person that would complete our team? Are you ready for a new challenge? Then apply now!We look forward to hearing from you**The Xelon Team**![Xelon AG]()* Xelon AG  Poststrasse 15  6300 Zug*jid42d59b0jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Project Consultant - Bereich Einwohner 80-100% (m/w/d)--- Project Consultant \- Bereich Einwohner 80\-100% (m/w/d)========================================================*Die Swiss Post Digital Government AG unterstützt die öffentlichen Verwaltungen der Schweiz bei ihrer digitalen Transformation mit modernen, sicheren ERP\-Lösungen, die speziell auf die Bedürfnisse von Gemeinden und Kantonen zugeschnitten sind. Dabei übernimmst du die fachliche Umsetzung der dir zugewiesenen Aufgaben und arbeitest eng mit dem zuständigen Projektmanager sowie weiteren internen Fachstellen zusammen. So trägst du dazu bei, die Prozesse der Einwohnerkontrolle effizient und nachhaltig zu gestalten. **Dein Wirkungsfeld*** In den dir zugewiesenen Kundenprojekten übernimmst du die fachliche Einführung unserer ERP\-Applikationen und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem zuständigen Projektmanager sowie den beteiligten internen Fachstellen zusammen. Du rapportierst an den Teamlead Projects.* Du übernimmst die fachliche Umsetzung der dir zugewiesenen Arbeitspakete bei der Einführung unserer Applikationen im Bereich Einwohnerkontrolle.* Du planst und koordinierst deine eigenen fachlichen Aktivitäten in enger Abstimmung mit dem Projektmanager.* Du parametrierst die Applikationen, führst Kundenschulungen durch und wirkst fachlich bei der Projektabnahme mit, sowohl vor Ort bei unseren Kunden in der Deutschschweiz als auch remote.* Du berätst unsere Kunden in fachlichen Fragen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Verwaltungsprozesse optimal auf unsere Lösungen abzustimmen.* Du unterstützt das Verkaufsteam bei Präsentationen für potenzielle Kunden und wirkst unter anderem bei der Vorbereitung von Pflichtenheften im Rahmen von Ausschreibungen mit. **Dein Profil*** Du verfügst über mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer Schweizer Gemeinde, insbesondere im Bereich Einwohnerkontrolle. Von grossem Vorteil sind praktische Kenntnisse unserer ERP\-Systeme Genowin NG und/oder Civetica.* Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit und hast Freude an der Beratung sowie an der Vermittlung von Wissen.* Du arbeitest selbstständig, sorgfältig und präzise, denkst vernetzt und bringst eine hohe Affinität zu Softwareapplikationen mit.* Von Vorteil bringst du Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Kundenprojekten als ERP\-Consultant mit. Ebenfalls geschätzt sind allgemeine Consulting\-Erfahrung oder Erfahrung als Fachspezialist in ERP\-Einführungsprojekten auf Kundenseite. Du verstehst die Bedeutung eines strukturierten Projektvorgehens.* Du bist bereit, regelmässig Kundeneinsätze in der Deutschschweiz wahrzunehmen.* Du bist neugierig und bereit, dich nebst dem Fachbereich Einwohnende auch in andere Fachbereiche einzuarbeiten.* Du beherrschst Deutsch auf Niveau C1 und Englisch auf Niveau B2, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. ösischkenntnisse (ab Niveau B1\) sind von Vorteil. **Deine Vorteile*** Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du arbeitest innerhalb der vereinbarten Ziele selbständig und gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenverantwortlich* Gezielte fachliche Weiterbildungen, damit du dein Wissen laufend vertiefen und dich beruflich weiterentwickeln kannst* Kostenloser Parkplatz in Baldegg, Möglichkeit von Homeoffice und attraktive Sozialleistungen Willst du dich, dein Fachwissen und deine Erfahrung bei uns einbringen?Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung. ![Swiss Post Digital Government AG]()* Swiss Post Digital Government AG  Rue du Technopôle 1  3960 Sierre*jid659af68jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Linux System Engineer
jobs.description: EinleitungstextAre you ready to take ownership of world-class Linux infrastructure in a dynamic biological research environment? At the Department of Biosystems Science and Engineering (D-BSSE) of ETH Zurich in Basel, data-driven science meets cutting-edge engineering.As the senior technical anchor for our Linux ecosystem, you will join a focused, close-knit infrastructure group of four. Linux and storage service delivery is shared across three team members (with our fourth colleague focusing on Windows and virtualization). In this position, you will lead the core technical architecture and operations, while two team members work somewhat more closely with daily client and customer support. Underpinning our local setup are the central services of ETH ID, providing robust networking, central storage, and a growing central Linux core.Whether you are already an experienced senior engineer or a talented, motivated Linux professional ready to step into a larger role and expand your capabilities, we offer the autonomy and support for you to thrive. If you want your engineering expertise to directly empower groundbreaking scientific progress, this is your place to grow!Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungLead Linux Infrastructure & Services: Take personal responsibility for the technical architecture, continuous development, and 3rd-level operations of our Linux ecosystem, including hosts, web/application platforms (e.g., LAMP), containerization, and Slurm workload management.Automate & Orchestrate Systems: Proactively design, deploy, and refine scalable configuration management tools (Ansible/Puppet), database hosts, and automation scripts to ensure high service availability and operational integrity.Manage Enterprise Storage & High-Performance Data: Provide and maintain robust UNIX/Linux storage (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID). Lead technical investigations into complex data challenges, optimize storage migrations, and safeguard data resilience.Secure Network & System Topologies: Own system security, disaster recovery protocols, and server/service lifecycle management. Define and enforce secure firewall rules, network configurations, and data integrity safeguards.Drive Strategic & Central Projects: Lead our local IT projects with high visibility and dependencies on central IT units, serving as the core technical liaison to deliver modern infrastructure solutions.Consult & Support Scientific Users: Act as an expert partner for internal research groups—advising on client/server specifications, delivering custom infrastructure solutions, and providing support for Linux workstations and servers.Foster Collaboration & Redundancy: Nurture team well-being and operational continuity by mentoring peers, building technical supporting skills redundancy.Ihr ProfilExpertise meets team spirit.You enjoy working as part of a team and value a service-oriented approach to your work. You are able to maintain a clear overview of complex issues and find it easy to get to grips with new technologies and customer needs. You have the following skills or similar:Professional Experience: A few years of hands-on Linux experience with strong foundational knowledge of Ubuntu and RedHat distributions, automation (Ansible and/or Puppet) and scripting, securing, and user-facing environments. Slurm experience is an advantage.Storage & Systems Expertise: Technical familiarity with Unix-related storage technologies (NFS, CIFS, Kerberos, CEPH, RAID), systems monitoring, and server hardware support.Virtualization & Services: Working experience with virtualization, container technologies, and web/application server security.Certifications & Growth: LPIC or Red Hat certification is preferred. We value continuous professional development and support your growth into the broader requirements of the position.Analytical & Methodological Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and a structured, proactive approach to system administration and planning, combined with a sense of innovation.Communication & Inclusivity: Excellent customer orientation, strong communication skills (in English, German an advantage) and an inclusive mindset for collaborating effectively within a diverse, multi-cultural academic environment.Wir bietenPosition-Specific Highlights:A role designed for professional growth, offering high personal autonomy and technical decision-making space.3rd-level systems engineering embedded within the cutting-edge D-BSSE scientific community in Basel.Strong team support with shared operational duties and opportunity to continuously develop your technical skills in a production environment.Comprehensive Benefits Package:Excellent financial security with attractive pension plans via PUBLICA.Public transport subsidies (SBB) and car-sharing options (Mobility).We live: Lifelong learningSee further here.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:Motivation letterCVWork and edication certificatesFurther information about D-BSSE can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Vernon Bailey, Head of IT Support vernon.bailey@bsse.ethz.ch (no application documents).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering
jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure. We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.For this purpose, we are looking for a Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering, who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThe job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:Scientific AI and physics-informed modellingDevelop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.AI-enabled numerical modellingDevelop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.Automation of experimental researchDevelop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.Geotechnical data intelligenceDevelop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.Scientific visualisation and communicationDevelop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.Group-wide AI capabilityHelp establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an intellectually curious scientist / engineer who combines strong computational skills with an interest in physical systems and engineering research. A background in geotechnical engineering is not mandatory but can represent an advantage.PhD in computational mechanics, computational engineering, scientific machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, civil or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline.Excellent programming skills.Strong background in numerical methods, such as FEM, FD, DEM or MPM.Demonstrated experience with machine learning, modern AI methods and AI-assisted software development.Experience with scientific data engineering, databases and the processing of large or heterogeneous datasets.Experience with HPC, parallel computing and/or GPU computing.Experience with automated simulation workflows and APIs.Experience with scientific visualisation and the automated generation of figures, animations or videos.Experience with computer vision and image/video analysis is particularly valuable.Candidates from other fields than geotechnical engineering with strong expertise in computational mechanics and Scientific AI are strongly encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced geotechnical researchers who will provide the necessary domain expertise.Beyond specific technical qualifications, we are particularly interested in candidates who can bridge disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to understand an engineering or scientific problem, identify where AI or computational methods can provide genuine added value, develop a rigorous solution, and transform that solution into a reusable capability for other researchers.We therefore value scientific creativity, strong software-development practices, independence, collaborative ability and an enthusiasm for learning new areas.The position is particularly suited to someone who is excited by the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Wir bietenThe opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computational mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Considerable freedom to identify research opportunities and contribute to the development of new methods as AI technologies and Scientific AI continue to evolve.The opportunity to work across scientific research, computational engineering, numerical simulations, experimental research and data science.Close collaboration with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary research environment.The opportunity to develop reusable AI-enabled tools and workflows that strengthen research capabilities across the group.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:CVMotivation letterDiplomaReference LettersFurther information about the Chair of Geotechnical Engineering can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr. Alexandru Marin, Tel. +41 44 633 7370 or alexandru.marin@igt.baug.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager

jobs.description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.Investment ManagementGenerate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre-agreed trading mandate.Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance-sheet-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.Take hands-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.Risk ManagementOperate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.Improve and scale risk-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.Performance, Monitoring and ReportingMonitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.Contribution to the Fund and the FirmContribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.Governance, Compliance and ConductOperate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times. WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:EssentialA minimum of 7–10 years’ experience in a principal risk-taking capacity, as a trader at a sell-side institution and/or as a Portfolio Manager, Sub-Portfolio Manager or Pod Portfolio Manager at a hedge fund or asset manager, trading global macro markets.A minimum of 3 years’ attributable, verifiable track record of managing risk capital, evidenced through audited or employer-confirmed P&L and risk reports, with the candidate’s own contribution clearly separable from that of any wider team.P&L of a scale that justifies a substantial allocation of institutional capital, together with evidence of having run a large book and of the ability to scale risk as capital grows.A high quality of returns, assessed through information ratio, maximum drawdown and recovery, hit rate and consistency across market regimes, with limited reliance on a small number of outsized trades. Returns generated through excessive leverage, concentration or tail-risk selling are not regarded as evidence of skill.Experience of running directional macro risk through periods of market stress and drawdown within a formal institutional risk framework, and of operating comfortably at the scale and volatility of a flagship global macro fund.A clearly articulated, proven and repeatable investment process that can be explained from first principles: the source of edge, how ideas are generated, how positions are sized and risk-managed, and how the process has adapted to changing market conditions.A strategy and return stream that would be diversifying within a global macro portfolio. DesirableExperience as a lead Portfolio Manager at a global macro hedge fund with a multi-asset mandate spanning developed and emerging markets.Experience of managing balance-sheet-intensive strategies and large gross exposures, including funding, repo and collateral management.Experience of building and leading a team of analysts, traders or sub-portfolio managers.Experience of expressing macro views across more than one asset class, for example rates and FX together with inflation, volatility, equity indices, credit or commodities.A postgraduate qualification (Master’s, PhD or MBA) and/or a relevant professional designation such as the CFA or FRM. TECHNICAL/BUSINESS SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:EssentialExpert understanding of the pricing, mechanics, risk characteristics and regulatory treatment of global rates, FX, inflation and volatility instruments: government bonds, interest rate and cross-currency swaps, futures, options and swaptions, other OTC derivatives and financing instruments.A sophisticated understanding of global macroeconomics, monetary and fiscal policy, central bank reaction functions and their transmission into financial markets.Fluency in portfolio risk measures (VaR, expected shortfall, stress and scenario analysis, DV01, Greeks, factor exposures, liquidity and correlation risk) and in interpreting and challenging risk system output.Strong quantitative skills, including statistics, time-series analysis and derivatives pricing; technical data analysis skills, with Python or a comparable language and Bloomberg proficiency expected.Detailed knowledge of market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, execution venues and transaction cost management in the relevant markets.Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, operational controls, counterparty and collateral arrangements, and the regulatory environment governing trading in the relevant jurisdictions.The ability to articulate complex investment views, risks and performance clearly and concisely to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and peers, verbally and in writing.Judgement under uncertainty, intellectual honesty, discipline under pressure and resilience through drawdowns; self-motivated and accountable, and able to operate in a collaborative organisation with unimpeachable integrity.A strong undergraduate degree from a respected academic institution in a rigorous discipline such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or computer science.DesirableExperience of building proprietary models, datasets and analytical tools, or of running a systematic overlay to a discretionary process.Established relationships with sell-side counterparties, brokers and liquidity providers

minded with strong strategic judgements.Strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Solution-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment.Able
