jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an **IT Manager** to join our team at Phillips Medisize in Kontiolahti.In this key site role, you will be responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services and infrastructure supporting our manufacturing operations. You will act as the primary interface between site operation and business functions, global IT organizations, and external technology partners.**What you will do**As IT Manager, you will have a broad and hands-on role in developing and supporting our local IT environment. Your key responsibilities include:- Maintaining and continuously developing the site's IT infrastructure to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations - Coordinating IT infrastructure upgrades, system improvements, and technology deployments - Providing local IT support and coordinating troubleshooting with global support teams and external service providers - Acting as the key link between site functions, global IT organizations, and technology vendors - Supporting the implementation of global IT initiatives, standards, and systems at site level - Supporting business continuity, including legacy applications where migration to global solutions is not feasible - Participating in IT budget planning and providing recommendations on technology investments and infrastructure development - Ensuring compliance with corporate IT policies, information security requirements, and applicable standards - Driving continuous improvement of IT services, systems, and business processes. **What we are looking for**You combine solid IT expertise with a strong understanding of business needs. You enjoy working close to operations and are comfortable collaborating with both local stakeholders and global IT teams.We expect you to have:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business information systems, or another relevant field. An equivalent combination of education and professional experience may also be considered. - Experience in IT infrastructure support, IT service management, business applications, or a business-facing IT role - Good understanding of IT infrastructure, end-user computing, enterprise applications, and network environments - Understanding of information security principles and corporate IT governance - Experience working with global IT organizations and external vendors - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills - A customer-oriented and service-minded approach - Ability to manage multiple priorities - Excellent communications skills in both Finnish and English Experience from a manufacturing environment and participation in IT projects are considered an advantage.**Why this role matters**This is an opportunity to work close to the heart of our manufacturing operations and have a tangible impact on how technology supports the site. You will combine hands-on local IT responsibility with global collaboration, helping ensure business continuity today while developing smarter, more efficient, and secure solutions for the future.You will work closely with site management, business functions, operation teams, global IT teams, end users, and external technology partners.

jobs.title: Markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntija
jobs.description: Primary location:TUUSULAHaemme markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntijaa Meira Novan markkinointi- ja viestintätiimiin. Tässä roolissa vastaat monipuolisesti yrityksemme markkinoinnin ja viestinnän suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta.Keskeisiä tehtäviäsi ovat markkinointi- ja myyntimateriaalien suunnittelu, tuottaminen ja jalkauttaminen monikanavaisesti, valikoimajaksojen ja sesonkien tuotetietojen koordinointi, verkkosivuston sisältöjen kehittäminen, asiakastapahtumien ja messujen koordinointi sekä sisäinen viestintä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin ja hankinnan sekä mainostoimistokumppaneiden ja toimittajien kanssa ja osallistut markkinoinnin ja viestinnän kehityshankkeisiin. Yhdistät työssäsi kaupallisen ajattelun, luovuuden ja vahvan toteutuskyvyn ja tuet kaupallisen tiimin menestystä ajan hermolla olevalla tuoteviestinnällä.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Sinulla on kokemusta markkinoinnin ja viestinnän laaja-alaisista tehtävistä sekä aktiivinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote. Olet järjestelmällinen ja huolellinen, toimit hyvin paineen alla ja työskentelet luontevasti sekä tiimissä että itsenäisesti. Sinulla on hyvä visuaalinen silmä, erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot sekä kiinnostusta foodservice-toimialaan. Soveltuva kaupallisen alan tai markkinoinnin ja viestinnän korkeakoulututkinto antaa hyvän pohjan tehtävään. Hyödynnät tekoälyä arjessasi ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Hallitset Adobe InDesignin ja Photoshopin, ja sinulla on kokemusta HubSpotista sekä projektinhallinnasta.Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen elintarvikealalta tai mainostoimistosta sekä tuotetietojen hallinnasta esimerkiksi GS1 Synkka- tai Akeneo PIM -järjestelmissä. Lisäksi arvostamme valokuvausosaamista sekä Contentfulin ja Canvan tuntemusta.Tule voittavaan joukkueeseenMeira Novan kaupallisessa organisaatiossa, jonka osana markkinointi- ja viestintätiimi toimii, työskentelee noin 50 henkilöä. Tässä joukkueessa taidamme itsenäisen työskentelyn, mutta nautimme siitä, että saamme tehdä toistemme kanssa töitä. Tehtävän huolellinen ja tehokas hoitaminen tuottaa korkeaa asiakastyytyväisyyttä sekä yritysmielikuvamme vahvistumista ja varmistaa osaltaan yksikön tavoitteiden saavuttamista.Työtyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää, ja siksi varmistamme, että työntekijät pääsevät mukaan muutosten suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen. Uskomme, että osallistaminen lisää sitoutumista ja tekee kehityksestä sujuvampaa – yhdessä rakennamme toimivampia ratkaisuja ja parempaa työarkea. Meillä on S-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut: https://s-ryhma.fi/tyopaikat/erinomaiset-edutMiltä tämä kaikki vaikutti? Varmimmin saat Lauran kiinnipe 13.11.2026 klo 14–15 tai pe 20.11.2026 klo 14–15.Osana S-ryhmää toimiva, vuonna 1991 perustettu Meira Nova on Suomen johtavia foodservice-alan tukkukauppoja. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme luotettavan kumppanuuden, johon on turvallista nojata nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Palvelemme 250 ammattilaisen voimin ravintoloita, hotelleja, liikenneasemia sekä terveys- ja hoivapalvelusektorin sekä julkishallinnon toimijoita. Logistiikkakeskuksemme sijaitsee Tuusulassa.

and social media tools, or a willingness to learn them quickly.•    A practical, hands-on approach to setting up rooms and equipment for events.•    Financial management, including budgeting, and reporting experience is required.•    Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for events.•    Experience working as part of a team and ability to direct staff and contractors•    Full driving licence Desirable•    Experience working in a university, innovation centre, incubator or co-working environment.•    Knowledge of, or interest in, the agri-food, agtech or veterinary sectors.•    Health and Safety or manual handling qualification, or first aid training.•    Experience of using a CRM or booking platform to manage leads and enquiries.What We Offer•    A salary of jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

jobs.title: Facility Director
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Director, you will lead Nordscale’s Facility Management unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the  unit ahead of and during the start of operations. You will hold overall responsibility for safe and stable operation of the facility, the buildings and the services around them, around the clock.

 

You will report to the Site Director and lead managers within quality, HSE, site coordination and logistics, sustainability and technical operations. 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the Facility Management unit, and prepare the organisation, procedures and suppliers for the start of operations in 2027.
  • Hold overall responsibility for safe, stable and efficient 24/7 operation of the facility. This includes building and site services such as property management, security, logistics, spare parts and sustainability.
  • Own the operational management system, including KPIs, meeting structure, reporting and follow-up. Build a strong safety and quality culture with strict operational discipline, and act as Incident Commander during major incidents.
  • Work closely with the Site Director, Nscale and IT teams. Manage supplier performance and budgets for maintenance, upgrades, energy and technical services. 

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

 You may be an experienced leader from data centres. You may also come from other technically complex, continuous operations where downtime has major consequences, such as process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, offshore, maritime operations, power or technical defence environments. Experience from establishing an operating organisation before a facility enters regular operation is an advantage. 

You are motivated by building something from the ground up, and you combine trust with clear follow-up. You know that following the standard and improving it are equally important parts of the same responsibility.

 

Key characteristics

  •  Structured and systematic, working with strong procedural discipline and attention to detail.
  • Resilient under pressure, identifying challenges and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.
  • Builds relationships of trust, collaboration and mutual respect, communicates clearly and listens actively.

 

Skills & Qualifications 

  •  Solid experience leading managers across several technical disciplines and support functions in 24/7 operations, together with subcontractors.
  • A strong track record in safety culture and HSE, including work and access permits, safe isolation, risk assessment and change management.
  • Experience with establishing and leading a performance management system, policies and procedures (SOPs etc) and supplier follow-up
  • Sound understanding of electrical, cooling and mechanical systems.
  • Experience from commissioning and start-up is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. 
  • A master’s degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering is preferred. Other relevant technical education combined with documented operational experience will also be considered. 
What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the operating organisation, procedures and safety culture from the ground up, and to lead Kvandal South into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.  
Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Oulaisiin
jobs.description: **Haemme ammattisiivoojaa avustamaan asiakastamme Oulaisissa.** **Mitä siivooja-helpperi tekee?** Siivooja-helpperi on henkilö, joka tukee asiakkaitamme ammatillisessa kotisiivouksessa. Asiakkaamme saa aina oman helpperinsä avukseen. Työ on mielekästä, sillä helpperinä pääset myös tutustumaan asiakkaaseen.Hemby tarjoaa kotisiivouksia tekeville helppereillemme laadukkaat siivousvälineet mikrokuituliinoista pesuaineisiin. Kotisiivouskäynneillä hyödynnämme asiakkaan imuria ja moppia lattioiden siistimiseen.**Mitä työ vaatii?** Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta. Lisäksi asiakaspalveluhenkisyys sekä reipas ote ovat työssä tarvittavia ominasuuksia. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat. Edellytämme työntekijöiltämme 18-vuoden ikää.**Mikä on Hemby?**Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:_"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."__"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."__Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan._**Siivooja-helpperinä saat:**- **Omat nimetyt asiakkaat**, joita autat kotisiivouksessa. - **Joustavat työajat,** jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa 2-6 tunnin ajan, riippuen asiakkaan asunnon koosta. - **Kilpailukykyisen palkan:** Tuntipalkka 13,20€-15,98€/h + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. - **Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet:** Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän työpanoksesi ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! - **Monipuolisen työn:** siivoojana voit halutessasi myös olla avuksi asiakkaillemme arjen muissa askareissa. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksiHakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen. Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää siivooja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working
   
   

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.

 - Fluency in additional languages

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: DGI Storkøbenhavn søger idrætskonsulent til gymnastik (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeninger?

Har du en faglighed inden for gymnastik og et stærkt foreningskendskab? 

Brænder du for at sammensætte og drive de helt rigtige kurser og uddannelser?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Storkøbenhavn.

Vi søger en konsulent, som kan arbejde strategisk og er en drivkraft i udviklingen af gymnastikken i Storkøbenhavn. Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med gymnastikforeningerne om udvikling, aktiviteter og uddannelse af instruktører og ledere.Du understøtter gymnastikforeningerne i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner og rådgiver. Du skal derfor kunne skabe gode relationer til nøglepersoner i gymnastikforeningerne samtidig med, at du kan inddrage kolleger med forskellige andre fagligheder. 

Det er især vigtigt, at du kan drive og udvikle vores kursus- og uddannelsesområde, så vores tilbud til gymnastikforeninger, frivillige og instruktører er attraktive og af høj kvalitet. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at

  • løbende kvalificere vores udbud af kurser og uddannelser
  • afdække behov hos foreninger og omsætte dem til relevante tilbud
  • udvikle nye kurser, uddannelser og skræddersyede forløb
  • rekruttere de rette undervisere og samarbejde tæt med dem
  • arbejde med synlighed og øge deltagelsen på vores kurser

DGI Storkøbenhavn har desuden indgået en række kommunepartnerskaber med henblik på at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for foreningsidrætten lokalt. I den forbindelse samarbejder vi med stærke og toneangivende foreninger om deres specifikke udfordringer og potentialer. En del af de foreninger er gymnastikforeninger, hvorfor du får en central rolle i disse udviklingsprocesser. 

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab i DGI Storkøbenhavns idrætsteam og vil også arbejde sammen med administrative medarbejdere og foreningskonsulenter.  

Din profil:

  • Faglig viden om gymnastik og ambitioner for udvikling af idrætten
  • Et skarpt blik for både udvikling og udbredelse af kurser og uddannelser
  • Erfaring som konsulent eller projektleder – du ved, hvordan man skaber fremdrift og resultater
  • Erfaring med foreningsudvikling og gerne kendskab til gymnastikforeningerne i Storkøbenhavn
  • En udadvendt og opsøgende tilgang – du trives med at skabe relationer og netværk
  • Kompetent bruger af administrative systemer

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt. Tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027. 

Det er en tidsbegrænset stilling med udløb 31. marts 2028.

Aften- og weekendarbejde vil forekomme. 

 

DGI Storkøbenhavn

Som idrætsforeningernes udviklingshus styrker vi idrætsforeningerne i en by i konstant forandring. jobs.title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

Du holder af at lave ordentlig mad. Af at smage til, bage fra bunden og sende et måltid afsted, du er stolt af. Og du vil gerne have tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

Vi laver mad fra bunden og bager selv vores brød – gerne med surdej. Her får du brugt dit håndværk på tværs af hverdagsmad, caféretter og selskabsmenuer. Og du får mulighed for at præge menuerne, ugens retter og måden, vi arbejder på.

God mad. Og tid til andet.

Arbejdet følger husets sæson. Vi arbejder mere om vinteren og har nedsat arbejdstid fra påske til september, så der er ekstra tid til at nyde de varme dage.

●     Weekendvagt hver femte weekend.

●     Kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret.

●     Færre arbejdstimer fra påske til september.

●     Et lille team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og giver plads til faglige input.

●     Indflydelse på maden og arbejdsgangene i køkkenet.

Der er også travle dage og arrangementer, der kræver, at vi løfter sammen. Du får en hverdag med både planlagt produktion og gæster i huset.

Du kan dit håndværk – og tager ansvar

Du er kok, ernæringsassistent, cater eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken. Det afgørende er, at du kan lave velsmagende mad fra bunden og arbejde selvstændigt med kvalitet og overblik.

jobs.title: Senior Partnership & Business Development
jobs.description:
Senior Partnership & Business Development

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der kan udvikle vores samarbejdspartnere og skabe stærke resultater gennem strategiske partnerskaber.

Studiz er bl.a. landets største platform for studierabat til verificerede studerende med mere end 400.000 medlemmer. Vores platform giver virksomheder mulighed for at opbygge en tidlig relation til fremtidens mest købestærke kundesegment. Se mere på www.studiz.dk.

Vi arbejder med samspillet mellem brands og studerende, og det er i dette krydsfelt, at din rolle skal udfolde sig i tæt samarbejde med vores CMO.

Du får budgetansvar for din egen portefølje og vil samtidig være den drivende kraft i flere interne projekter, hvor du skal hjælpe og vejlede vores praktikanter og studentermedhjælpere.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Strategisk rådgivning: Være en aktiv sparringspartner, der kan udfordre eksisterende tilgange og rådgive om, hvordan samarbejdet kan skabe størst mulig værdi for partnerens forretning.

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultater på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser. Hvilken betydning har eksempelvis billeder, budskaber, formater og sendetidspunkter for engagement og handling?

  • Test og optimering: Opstille hypoteser, teste nye initiativer og evaluere effekten. Bruge resultaterne til løbende at forbedre vores aktiviteter og skabe bedre resultater for både partnere og brugere.

En central del af stillingen er at forstå og udvikle samspillet mellem tre områder: vores partnere, vores egen forretning og vores brugere.

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Vi skal med andre ord ikke blot kunne aflæse vores data, men også forstå, hvad der ligger bag tallene, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte indsigterne til handling. Det kræver en person, der kombinerer analytisk nysgerrighed med kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at se det større perspektiv.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling inden for marketing og dermed både kommerciel og strategisk forståelse samt dokumenterede resultater.

  • Er analytisk og motiveres af at arbejde med data, indsigter og performance.

  • Er nysgerrig på brugeradfærd og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver engagement og handling.

  • Kan se sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Har forståelse for at arbejde med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med nye idéer.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

Herudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til både affiliate- og bureauverdenen.

Men vigtigst af alt er det, at du er nysgerrig på forretningen, menneskene og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det endnu bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

Derudover får du:

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Stor arbejdsfrihed.

  • Sociale arrangementer.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til job@studiz.dk

Ansøgninger modtages løbende, og vi indkalder til samtaler, indtil den rette kandidat er fundet. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sille Kaalund på tel. 50 40 62 80.

Når du sender din ansøgning og dit CV, accepterer du, at vi opbevarer dine personlige oplysninger, så længe rekrutteringsprocessen varer.

Studiz er en dansk virksomhed, skabt og drevet af studerende, med det formål at gøre hverdagen sjovere, billigere og enklere for verificerede studerende. Siden 2013 har Studiz hjulpet virksomheder med at opbygge loyalitet og gjort det nemmere for studerende at få adgang til studierabatter, bl.a. via det personlige digitale studiekort i Studiz-app'en.

jobs.title: Researcher
jobs.description:
About the position

A full-time researcher position (SKO 1109) is available at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC), Department of Psychology (PSI), Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Oslo. The researcher will work full time on the Horizon Europe project SHIELD - Sources of Health Inequalities from Environmental Pollution in Lifespan Brain Development, funded by the Horizon Europe programme. SHIELD investigates how environmental exposures affect brain health and brain diseases across the entire lifespan, from conception to old age. 

The position will focus on environmental exposure modelling and the generation of environmental exposure maps for the SHIELD cohorts, as well as MRI data analysis. We are particularly looking for a candidate who can work at the interface of brain imaging and environmental exposure data, with a strong research background in MRI data analysis and experience with using environmental and geographic databases. Transdisciplinary experience and interest will be an advantage, as the consortium involves partners from multiple fields, including (but not limited to) psychology, medicine, physics, environmental epidemiology and statistical modelling. 

As SHIELD is expected to generate significant impacts, the researcher will be expected also to contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities, for example by participating in stakeholder workshops and contributing to policy briefs, newsletters, and social media posts. 

The research position is funded until the end of the project, 31 December 2031. LCBC is the coordinator of the SHIELD consortium, which includes 13 partners, and this position will be one of the key roles in the entire consortium. The position and its associated tasks are funded only for the stated period and will end when the funding period expires.

More about the position and the research center

The goal of LCBC is to understand differences and changes in brain and cognition across the entire lifespan, and to identify how brain function and cognition can be optimized. LCBC is an active, multidisciplinary research center with around 25 full-time staff members, including four professors, two researchers, several postdoctoral fellows and PhD candidates, chief and senior data engineers, full- and part-time research assistants, administrative support, and several affiliated international researchers. 

LCBC has excellent research infrastructure, including access to a 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanner, PET and EEG facilities, and comprehensive neuropsychological and somatic testing facilities. English is the main working language at the center.

LCBC has secured several large grants, including four European Research Council (ERC) grants, a Horizon 2020 grant, and several grants from the Research Council of Norway, the National Health Association of Norway, and the University of Oslo. In 2015, the group was designated “world-leading” and is one of only five such groups at the University of Oslo. More information is available on the LCBC website: https://www.lcbc.uio.no. 

Your main tasks will be
  • Processing and analyzing multimodal brain MRI (structural, diffusion, and quantitative imaging) and cognitive trajectory and modeling these in relation to exposures. 
  • Processing and analyzing behavioral and health data and modeling these in relation to brain and exposure data. 
  • Characterizing and modelling historical air pollution concentrations (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, etc.) for the SHIELD cohorts by integrating Chemical Transport Model (CTM) simulation outputs with emission inventories and observational datasets. 
  • Generating environmental exposure maps extending back to 1920 by combining diverse open-source datasets (meteorological, emissions, and land-use data) for SHIELD's Age-Period-Cohort (APC)-corrected analyses.
  • Contribute to harmonization, expansion and application of EXPANSE maps. 
  • Collaborate with other SHIELD researchers and participate in the SHIELD consortium meetings. 
  • Write and publish scientific articles. 
  • Contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities of SHIELD: participating at workshops, writing policy-briefs, newsletters, social media posts etc.
Qualifications

In this role you must have 

  • PhD in a relevant field such as Neuroscience, Meteorology, Physics, Biophysics, Complex systems, Data Modelling, or a highly related, quantitative natural science/interdisciplinary field. 
  • Research experience in Computational Neuroimaging analysis (structural, functional, diffusion, or quantitative MRI). 
  • Experience with the use of meteorological/climate, spatial, or similar multidimensional databases. 
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R. 
  • Very good proficiency in written and spoken English is a prerequisite.

It is an advantage if you have

  • Experience with secure computing and data-handling environments suitable for sensitive human cohort data. 
  • Experience with research in interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary research environments. 
  • Experience in science communication and outreach activities.
Personal qualities

In the evaluation of applicants, emphasis will be placed on the following personal skills: 

  • Cooperation skills, and the ability to successfully join an international academic collaboration. 
  • Professional and personal ability to work independently.   

In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed upon the quality of the candidate's academic qualifications. Interviews with selected candidates will be arranged where the applicant's prerequisites, interest in and motivation for the field of research, and cooperative skills will be assessed. 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed, highly competent colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK 720 000 - 820 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Planned start date: 1st April 2027.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Letter of application, 1-2 pages, explaining the motivation for applying.
  • Curriculum Vitae summarizing education, positions, and academic work.
  • Copies of educational certificates, publications/academic work (if any) that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee.
  • Names and contact details of at least two references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number).
  • International applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University’s grading system.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Psychology is one of seven units of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and has 75 permanent and 70 temporary members of scientific staff. Degrees are offered at bachelor and master level, plus a clinical training programme, and the PhD programme has 140 students.

jobs.title: Nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience analyzing ECG reports
jobs.description:
At Cortrium, we are improving cardiac diagnostics with innovative and user-friendly ECG technology used by healthcare professionals in over 20 countries.

We are looking for a dedicated nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience in ECG analysis and interpretation to strengthen our team and contribute to our continued growth.

About the role

Our ECG analysis department is an international team of 35 dedicated colleagues, including cardiac nurses, cardiac technicians, lab technicians, cardiologists, and general practitioners. We offer regular training sessions to promote learning and professional development.

 Your responsibilities:

  • Quality review of ECG analyses

  • Provide feedback to our R&D team to help further develop our ECG analysis system and ensure optimal results for both healthcare professionals and patients

About you

Your qualifications:

  • Background as a cardiac nurse or ECG/cardiac technician

  • At least two years of experience in cardiology

  • Team player with the drive to make a difference

  • Systematic and detail-oriented

  • Fluent in English, and/or Danish

What we offer

Hours, and work environment: 

  • Part-time or full-time

jobs.title: Chefs Wanted - Porto Sociale - Italian Restaurant
jobs.description:
Join an exciting new chapter in Italian dining!

Porto Sociale, an Italian restaurant in the heart of Oslo, is undergoing a major transformation. With a refreshed concept, upgraded premises, and ambitious plans, we are preparing to create an exceptional Italian dining experience.

 

We are now looking for passionate and skilled chefs who want to become part of our new kitchen team.

Our vision is to combine authentic Italian traditions with high-quality ingredients, excellent craftsmanship, and a modern approach to hospitality. From handmade pasta and outstanding pizza to carefully prepared seafood, meat, and regional Italian specialties, we want to showcase the very best of Italian cuisine.

 

This is an exciting opportunity to join a restaurant during its relaunch and help shape its future.

Your responsibilities
  • Prepare and present high-quality dishes according to the restaurant's standards.
  • Work across different kitchen sections, including pasta, meat, fish, and hot kitchen.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and attention to detail in every dish.
  • Maintain excellent food safety, hygiene, and kitchen organization.
  • Collaborate closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team.
  • Contribute ideas and creativity to menu development and daily operations.
  • Help create a positive, professional, and efficient working environment.
Who are we looking for?
  • Previous experience as a chef in a professional restaurant kitchen.
  • A genuine passion for Italian cuisine and quality ingredients.
  • Experience with Italian cooking, fine dining, or premium restaurants is an advantage.
  • Experience with Italian pizza is a big advantage.
  • Good knowledge of cooking techniques, preparation, and presentation.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards.
  • A positive attitude, strong teamwork skills, and willingness to learn.
  • Good communication skills in English. Norwegian or Italian is a plus.
  • Flexibility and motivation to contribute across different kitchen stations.

We welcome applications from chefs with different specializations and experience levels, particularly those with strong skills in Italian cuisine, seafood, meat, grilling, or pasta.

What we offer
  • The opportunity to be part of an exciting restaurant relaunch in central Oslo.
  • A modernized restaurant with ambitious plans for the future.
  • The chance to work with authentic Italian cuisine and quality ingredients.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the development of a new kitchen team.
  • A professional and supportive working environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Interested?

Are you passionate about cooking and ready for a new challenge in Oslo?

We would love to hear from you!

 

Send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself. Tell us about your experience, culinary interests, and why you would like to join Porto Sociale.

 

Come help us create the next chapter of Porto Sociale!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Located in Aker Brygge, Oslo, Porto Sociale is an Italian restaurant preparing for an exciting new chapter. With a major renovation, a refreshed concept, and ambitious plans for the future, we aim to create one of Oslo’s most exciting Italian dining destinations. Our vision is to combine authentic Italian traditions with high-quality ingredients, exceptional food, and warm, personal service. From outstanding pizza and handmade pasta to carefully prepared seafood, meat, and regional Italian specialties, we want to showcase the very best of Italian cuisine.

jobs.title: Servicemand søges – erfaring er ikke et krav, men gåpåmod er!
jobs.description:
Jes Pedersen Sorø ApS søger en ny kollega til vores serviceteam.

Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på, og kan du lide et praktisk arbejde med forskellige opgaver? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Vi søger en servicemand, der primært skal beskæftige sig med slibning af betongulve samt mindre reparationer og udbedringer i forbindelse med vores beton- og kloakarbejde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Slibning og efterbehandling af betongulve

  • Mindre reparationer og udbedringer af betonarbejde

  • Mindre service- og reparationsopgaver i forbindelse med kloakarbejde

  • Diverse forefaldende praktiske opgaver

 

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med netop disse arbejdsopgaver. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og trives med praktisk arbejde.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og er praktisk anlagt

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan tage fat

  • Har lyst til at lære nye arbejdsopgaver

  • Er omhyggelig og sætter en ære i at levere et ordentligt stykke arbejde

  • Har kørekort (B) og trailerkørekort (B/E) – begge dele er et krav

Erfaring fra bygge- og anlægsbranchen er en fordel, men bestemt ikke en nødvendighed.

Vi sørger for oplæring

Du bliver ikke kastet ud i opgaverne på egen hånd fra første dag.

Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med en erfaren kollega, som sørger for, at du bliver grundigt oplært i arbejdsopgaverne.

For os er den rette indstilling og lysten til at lære vigtigere end et langt CV.

Hvem er vi?

Jes Pedersen Sorø ApS er en entreprenørvirksomhed med speciale i beton-, kloak- og anlægsarbejde.

Vi udfører blandt andet fundamenter, terrændæk og kloakarbejde i forbindelse med boligbyggeri og større byggeprojekter.

Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, ordentlighed og samarbejde.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Kontakt Dan for at høre mere om stillingen eller for at søge jobbet.

Telefon: 23 64 79 62

Mail: dan@jespedersen.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Jes Pedersen Sorø ApS

jobs.title: Dygtig rengøringsassistent på fuldtid  (37 timer pr. uge) - Experienced Full-Time Cleaning Assistant – (37 Hours Per Week)
jobs.description:
***English below*** RenTid søger en dygtig rengøringsassistent på fuldtid – 37 timer

Har du erfaring med professionel rengøring, og sætter du en ære i at levere et resultat, der er helt i top? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Hos RenTid går vi ikke på kompromis med kvaliteten. Vi tror på, at godt rengøringsarbejde handler om mere end bare at gøre rent – det handler om grundighed, ansvarlighed og stolthed over det arbejde, man leverer.

Vi søger derfor en engageret og kvalitetsbevidst medarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med professionel rengøring – dette er et ufravigeligt krav.

  • Kan lide at gøre rent og sætter en ære i at levere et perfekt resultat – hver eneste gang.

  • Har kørekort kategori B.

  • Er tryg ved at køre bil rundt i Aarhus.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Er indstillet på at arbejde hos både private kunder og erhvervskunder.

  • Er fleksibel og kan arbejde i weekender efter behov.

  • Som minimum kan tale og forstå engelsk. Kan du også lidt dansk, er det et stort plus.

  • Kan fremvise en gyldig straffeattest.

  • Har lovligt opholds- og arbejdstilladelse i Danmark (hvis dette er påkrævet for dig).

  • Er stabil, grundig og har øje for selv de små detaljer.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

  • En alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige kunder og opgaver.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk er i centrum.

  • Et selvstændigt job med ansvar og frihed under ansvar.

  • En virksomhed i udvikling med fokus på kvalitet og kundetilfredshed.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og lidt om dig selv til RenTid på [indsæt e-mailadresse].

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!Sådan søger du stillingen

Vær opmærksom på følgende krav til din ansøgning:

  • Ansøgninger modtages udelukkende pr. e-mail.

  • Det hjælper ikke at ringe vedrørende stillingen. Vi behandler kun skriftlige ansøgninger.

  • Din ansøgning skal vedhæftes et opdateret CV med billede.

  • Du skal desuden vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning, hvor du fortæller, hvorfor du søger stillingen, og hvorfor du mener, at du er den rette kandidat til RenTid.

Ufuldstændige ansøgninger vil som udgangspunkt ikke komme i betragtning.

Send din samlede ansøgning til: info@ren-tid.dk

RenTid – Professionel rengøring med fokus på kvalitet. RenTid is Hiring! Experienced Full-Time Cleaning Assistant – 37 Hours per Week

Do you have experience in professional cleaning, and do you take pride in delivering outstanding results? Then you might be the person we are looking for!

At RenTid, we never compromise on quality. We believe professional cleaning is about more than just cleaning – it is about attention to detail, responsibility and taking pride in your work.

We are looking for a dedicated and quality-conscious employee for a full-time position of 37 hours per week.

What we expect from you:

  • Previous experience in professional cleaning is essential.

  • You genuinely enjoy cleaning and take pride in delivering a perfect result every single time.

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence.

  • You are comfortable driving a car around Aarhus.

  • You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

  • You are willing to work at both private homes and commercial premises.

  • You are flexible and available to work weekends when required.

  • You can speak and understand English at a minimum. Speaking some Danish is a definite advantage.

  • You can provide a valid criminal record certificate.

  • You have legal residency and the right to work in Denmark (where applicable).

  • You are reliable, thorough and have an eye for detail.

What we offer:

  • A full-time position of 37 hours per week.

  • A varied working day with different customers and assignments.

  • A workplace where quality and professional standards come first.

  • An independent role with responsibility and freedom.

  • An expanding company focused on quality and customer satisfaction.

Does this sound like the right job for you?

We would love to hear from you!

Please send your application and a little information about yourself to RenTid at [insert email address].

We look forward to hearing from you!How to Apply

Please note the following application requirements:

  • Applications are accepted by email only.

  • Please do not call regarding the position. Phone enquiries will not influence the recruitment process.

  • Your application must include an updated CV with a photo.

  • You must also attach a motivational cover letter explaining why you are interested in the position and why you would be a good fit for RenTid.

Incomplete applications may not be considered.

Please send your complete application to: info@ren-tid.dk

RenTid – Professional Cleaning with a Focus on Quality.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Singapore
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

We’re hiring the first recruiter on the ground in Singapore to build Notion’s GTM team across Southeast Asia. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. You’ll also have a direct hand in shaping the culture of the SEA team as it forms, and be the subject matter expert on the ground.

You’ll use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for, and help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. We work from our Singapore office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own Singapore and SEA GTM hiring, from BDRs and Solutions Consultants to Outcomes Architects and field sales leadership, and help shape what the team looks like as it scales.

 - Establish the recruiting motion locally by building the process, systems, stakeholder rhythms, and candidate experience for SEA.

 - Help shape the culture of the SEA team as it forms, setting the hiring bar and the candidate experience that define what it feels like to join Notion here.

 - Partner directly with APAC GTM leadership on org design, role definition, market realities, and hiring decisions, and be the advisor they trust on what is achievable in the market.

 - Own complex and ambiguous searches end to end, setting strategy, diagnosing problems, pivoting when needed, and driving toward an outcome without waiting for direction.

 - Build deep Singapore and APAC talent networks and market intelligence, and use both to improve where and how Notion competes for talent.

 - Navigate high-stakes candidate and stakeholder situations, including compensation and closing conversations, with clarity and strong judgment.

 - Identify patterns across roles and regions and drive solutions that improve how the wider Recruiting team works.

 - Mentor teammates and share repeatable practices as the APAC team scales.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - A strong record of GTM hiring in Singapore and APAC across BDR, sales, solutions consulting, and field leadership roles.

 - Deep recruiting craft across sourcing, assessment, candidate engagement, offer strategy, and close.

 - A strong record of delivering complex, ambiguous, or first-of searches and building the playbook when one does not exist.

 - Experience influencing senior sales leaders as a talent advisor and recruiting subject matter expert.

 - Strong situational awareness and business maturity, with the judgment to navigate competing priorities and know when to push back or escalate.

 - A systems mindset and evidence of improving team practices beyond your own portfolio.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools that improve recruiting quality and leverage.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience as an early recruiting hire in a market or region, setting up the motion while hiring at pace.

 - Experience owning the end-to-end hiring process at a global SaaS company.

 - Experience hiring across multiple APAC markets.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

  • Mogućnost neprestanog učenja i usavršavanja
  • Dodatak za topli obrok
  • Prigodne nagrade
  • Korištenje MultiSport kartice
