jobs.title: Postdoc in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
jobs.description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a 24-month postdoctoral position in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing interactions between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid.

Your work tasksYou will develop and apply dynamic process models based on mass and energy balances, thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, and equipment behaviour to simulate integrated Power-to-X plants under changing operating conditions. The work will address renewable fuel production, particularly green methanol and sustainable aviation fuels through methanol-based and Fischer–Tropsch pathways. The work will focus on electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage, heat integration, and interactions with the electrical grid.

You will combine process simulation with operational optimization, process control, techno-economic assessment, and model validation to investigate flexible operation under varying renewable electricity generation and energy prices.

You will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, publish scientific results, contribute to project meetings and deliverables, and present findings at conferences and workshops. The position may also include limited teaching and supervision of bachelor’s and master’s students.

Your competenciesYou hold a PhD in chemical engineering, process engineering, or a closely related field, completed by the application deadline. You have documented research experience in process modelling and simulation, preferably including dynamic modelling of chemical or energy processes.

Hands-on experience with Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or Aspen Dynamics will be considered a strong advantage. Experience with gPROMS, Modelica, or comparable process-simulation tools is also relevant. Strong skills in MATLAB, Python, or a similar computational environment are expected.

Experience with Power-to-X, renewable fuels, optimization, process control, model validation, techno-economic assessment, or grid-integrated energy systems will strengthen your profile.

You will work closely with industrial and international partners. Therefore, the ability to translate research into practical solutions and communicate effectively across disciplines is essential. We value candidates who are proactive, structured, collaborative, and motivated to publish high-quality research and contribute actively to project activities.

Who we areYou will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy and electrical engineering. The group works with modelling, simulation, control, optimization and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance. We offer laboratory and workshop facilities, and a collaborative environment that supports innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development.

Learn more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. You must submit a co-author statement, see template for co-author statement 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Dansk kundesupport til spillekonsoler på Cypern
jobs.description:
Interesserer du dig for gaming og teknologi? Og har du lyst til at prøve hverdagen i udlandet? Så kan dit næste job være i Larnaca på Cypern, hvor du hjælper danske kunder med spørgsmål om spillekonsoler, brugerkonti og onlinetjenester.

Jobsun søger på vegne af en international virksomhed dansktalende medarbejdere til kundesupport inden for gaming. Du bliver en del af et internationalt team og får grundig oplæring, så du er klar til at hjælpe kunderne.

Hjælp kunderne tilbage til spillet

Når en kunde ikke kan logge ind, oplever problemer med forbindelsen eller har spørgsmål til en betaling, er du klar til at hjælpe.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Yde dansk kundesupport via telefon, chat og e-mail.

  • Hjælpe med spørgsmål om spillekonsoler og tilhørende onlinetjenester.

  • Guide kunder ved problemer med login, adgangskoder og brugerkonti.

  • Besvare spørgsmål om betalinger og fakturering.

  • Fejlfinde tekniske problemer og sende komplekse sager videre til det rette team.

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke være ekspert i spillekonsoler. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på teknologi, kan bevare overblikket og har lyst til at hjælpe andre.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk på meget højt niveau, svarende til C2.

  • Har engelskkundskaber på minimum B2-niveau.

  • Har afsluttet en gymnasial uddannelse eller tilsvarende.

  • Er fortrolig med IT og god til at forklare løsninger på en forståelig måde.

  • Er tålmodig, serviceminded og løsningsorienteret.

  • Er EU-borger og enten bor på Cypern eller ønsker at flytte dertil.

Erfaring med kundeservice eller teknisk support er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Interesse for gaming og spillekonsoler vil være en fordel i hverdagen.

Arbejdstid, løn og oplæring

Du arbejder 40 timer om ugen fra virksomhedens kontor i Larnaca. Vagterne ligger mandag til fredag inden for kl. 09.00–19.30, lokal tid, så du har fri i weekenden.

Du starter med fem ugers oplæring, som foregår mandag til fredag kl. 10.00–18.45, lokal tid.

Den faste månedsløn er 1.350 euro før skat, som stiger til 1.400 euro efter seks måneders ansættelse.

Du tilbydes en toårig kontrakt med mulighed for efterfølgende tidsubegrænset ansættelse. Prøvetiden er seks måneder.

Hjælp til at komme afsted

Hvis du flytter til Cypern, kan du vælge mellem to flyttepakker:

  • 1.500 euro i flyttetilskud, udbetalt 2–3 uger efter jobstart. Du arrangerer og betaler i første omgang selv fly og bolig.

  • Refusion af flybillet på op til 300 euro samt mulighed for indkvartering gennem virksomheden i op til to måneder. Første måned er gratis, og anden måned koster 100 euro. Du booker selv flybilletten.

De nærmere betingelser for flyttepakken gennemgås under rekrutteringsprocessen.

Jobsun er med dig under hele opholdet

Et nyt job i et andet land er et stort skridt, og du skal have nogen at række ud til. Derfor er Jobsun din kontaktperson og mentor både før afrejse, under opstarten og gennem hele dit ophold.

Du kan altid kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål om jobbet, hverdagen på Cypern eller noget praktisk, du har brug for hjælp til. Vi hjælper dig med at finde en løsning, så du ikke står alene med udfordringerne.

Interesseret? Et CV er nok

Forventet opstart er 2. november 2026, og fristen for at sende dit CV er 25. oktober 2026.

Send dit CV via ansøgningsmuligheden i opslaget. Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning.

Rekrutteringsprocessen omfatter en sprogtest og en samtale på dansk og engelsk. Jobsun står for den indledende rekruttering og hjælper dig gennem processen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vores koncept er running sushi, hvor vi tilbyder et bredt udvalg af både kolde og varme retter på båndet. Derudover tilbyder vi à la carte-retter til servering og takeaway.

  • Du er vant til at arbejde i et travlt køkken og kan bevare overblikket under pres

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også med teamwork

jobs.title: One or more PhD Stipends in Direct Air Capture Technologies
jobs.description:
The future of climate action extends beyond reducing emissionsAtmospheric CO2 concentrations continue to rise despite global efforts to reduce emissions. Achieving climate neutrality will therefore require not only deep emission reductions but also large-scale carbon removal solutions. Direct Air Capture (DAC) is one of the few technologies capable of permanently removing CO2 directly from the atmosphere, but significant scientific and engineering challenges remain before DAC can be deployed at gigaton scale. Future DAC systems must be energy-efficient, economically viable, and designed around a fundamental understanding of how materials, processes, and system integration interact.

At Aalborg University, we are seeking ambitious PhD candidates who want to help develop the next generation of DAC technologies through advanced process modelling, experimental studies, and techno-economic evaluations.

The stipend is open for appointment from 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

In the future, removing CO2 from the atmosphere will become an essential part of climate action.Atmospheric CO2 is already changing the climate. Reducing emissions is essential, but it may not be enough. We must also learn how to remove carbon already present in the atmosphere. Future Direct Air Capture systems will not simply capture CO2:

They will integrate with renewable energy systems. They will operate flexibly and balance the energy systems. They will become scalable climate infrastructure.

What this PhD is really aboutThe stipends are designed to contribute to two ambitious research initiatives that aim to accelerate the development of Direct Air Capture technologies:

Development of process-aware methodologies for evaluating emerging DAC liquid and solid sorbents and technologies. Development of predictive frameworks linking sorbent properties to process-level DAC performance.

Together, these efforts seek to establish the scientific foundations required to move DAC development from empirical trial-and-error toward predictive, data-driven design and scale-up.

The research environment and culture you will step intoYou will join CarbonLab at Aalborg University, a growing research environment dedicated to carbon capture, carbon removal, and climate-positive technologies. We are a group of approximately 20 people currently represented by 7 different nationalities. Our research combines laboratory experiments, process modelling, experimental validation, techno-economic and LCA assessments, and system integration to accelerate the deployment of DAC solutions at scale.

At CarbonLab, we are building more than technologies; we are building a research community. Our researchers share ideas openly, collaborate across disciplines, and celebrate each other's successes. PhD students are treated as colleagues, encouraged to develop their own scientific identity, and supported in taking initiative from the very beginning. Whether presenting at international conferences, contributing to teaching, leading collaborations, or exploring new research directions, you will be part of a culture that combines scientific ambition with mutual trust and genuine support. We believe that excellent research and an excellent research environment go hand in hand.

Your research qualificationsWe are looking for highly motivated candidates who are passionate about addressing climate change through scientific research and technological innovation. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, and is eager to contribute to the development of next-generation carbon removal technologies.

You should hold a master's degree (or be close to completion) in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Energy Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline.

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

Direct Air Capture, carbon capture, or carbon removal technologies Chemical process engineering and process intensification Mass transfer, reaction engineering, and thermodynamics Experimental design and laboratory testing Spectroscopy and related analytical techniques such as Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR). Measurement and interpretation of gas-liquid and gas-solid equilibrium data and breakthrough experiments. Process modelling and simulation (e.g., Aspen Plus, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools) Data analysis, optimization, and uncertainty assessment Techno-economic analysis and sustainability assessment Energy systems integration and renewable energy technologies

In addition, we value candidates who:

Demonstrate scientific curiosity and creativity Take initiative and ownership of their research Enjoy working both independently and collaboratively Communicate scientific results effectively in written and spoken English Thrive in an interdisciplinary and international research environment Are motivated to contribute to solutions with real-world climate impact

Previous research experience through master's projects, internships, conference contributions, or scientific publications is considered an advantage but is not a formal requirement.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate. We offer access to advanced laboratories and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (2-5 pages), that describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Head Chef – Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine - HOLY Group - XIN CHAO Kitchen
jobs.description:
English (Danish below)

Job Title: Head Chef – Authentic Vietnamese Cuisine

Company: HOLY Group - XIN CHÀO Kitchen

Location: Slotsgade 11, st., 6000 Kolding, Denmark

About Us:

XIN CHÀO Kitchen is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant committed to bringing the rich culinary heritage and flavors of Vietnam to Denmark. We take pride in traditional cooking techniques, high-quality ingredients, and exceptional dining experiences.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Head Chef to lead our kitchen team and oversee all culinary operations specializing in authentic Vietnamese specialty dishes.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Plan, direct, and supervise all preparation and cooking activities.

·       Create and maintain authentic Vietnamese menus and seasonal specialty dishes.

·       Ensure strict hygiene, food safety, and sanitation standards.

·       Maintain high standards of food quality, presentation, and consistency.

Requirements:

·       Mandatory: Masterful culinary expertise and proven professional experience in preparing authentic Vietnamese specialty dishes.

·       Strong knowledge of traditional Vietnamese herbs, spices, flavor profiles, and cooking techniques.

·       Prior experience working in established Vietnamese restaurants or high-volume Asian dining establishments.

We Offer:

·       A full-time position offering standard Danish working conditions (37 hours/week).

·       Salary fully compliant with the Danish Supplementary Pay Limit Scheme (Den supplerede beløbsordning).

·       A supportive and professional working environment.

How to Apply:

Please send your CV to xinchaokolding@gmail.com or apply directly via Jobnet.

Application Deadline: 30-11-2026

-------------------------

Dansk 

Om os

XIN CHÀO Kitchen er en autentisk vietnamesisk restaurant, der har til formål at bringe Vietnams rige kulinariske arv og smagsoplevelser til Danmark. Vi lægger stor vægt på traditionelle madlavningsteknikker, råvarer af høj kvalitet og en enestående gastronomisk oplevelse.

Stillingen

Vi søger en erfaren og passioneret Head Chef, som kan lede vores køkkenteam og have det overordnede ansvar for alle køkkenets kulinariske aktiviteter med særligt fokus på autentiske vietnamesiske specialiteter.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

·       Planlægge, lede og føre tilsyn med alle forberedelses- og madlavningsaktiviteter.

·       Udvikle og vedligeholde autentiske vietnamesiske menuer samt sæsonbaserede specialiteter.

·       Sikre høje standarder for hygiejne, fødevaresikkerhed og rengøring.

·       Opretholde høje standarder for madens kvalitet, præsentation og ensartethed.

Kvalifikationer

·       Obligatorisk: Fremragende kulinariske kompetencer samt dokumenteret professionel erfaring med tilberedning af autentiske vietnamesiske specialiteter.

·       Solidt kendskab til traditionelle vietnamesiske urter, krydderier, smagsprofiler og madlavningsteknikker.

·       Tidligere erfaring fra etablerede vietnamesiske restauranter eller asiatiske restauranter med høj aktivitet.

Vi tilbyder

·       En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen under almindelige danske arbejdsforhold.

·       En løn, der fuldt ud overholder kravene i den supplerede beløbsordning.

·       Et professionelt og støttende arbejdsmiljø.

Send venligst dit CV til xinchaokolding@gmail.com, eller søg stillingen direkte via Jobnet.

jobs.title: Logistikassistent – indkøb og planlægning

Til vores nye fabrik i Gedved søger vi en struktureret kollega, der trives med mange bolde i luften

Har du lyst til at være med helt fra begyndelsen? Vi er en ny virksomhed i opstartsfasen og har brug for en person, der kan hjælpe os med at skabe overblik, struktur og gode arbejdsgange – fra det første indkøb, til varen står klar til produktionen.

Om RENTEQ

RENTEQ ApS blev grundlagt i 2023 og ombygger brugte dieselvarebiler, busser og entreprenørmaskiner til eldrift med egenudviklede konverteringskits – til gavn for både klimaet og kundernes økonomi. Vi har udviklingsværksted i Dragør og en nyåbnet fabrik i Gedved, som giver os større kapacitet og kortere leveringstid til vores kunder og partnere.

Om stillingen

Vi leder efter en logistikassistent – en slags blæksputte – der er struktureret, men også fleksibel nok til at skifte spor, når hverdagen kræver det, og som synes, det er spændende at bygge systemer og procedurer op frem for blot at følge dem.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

•       Indkøb af materialer og komponenter samt dialog med leverandører

•       Planlægning i tæt samarbejde med produktionen

•       Oprettelse og vedligeholdelse af stamdata

•       Et godt og effektivt flow på lagerets indgang

•       Opbygning af vores systemer, arbejdsgange og procedurer

•       Diverse ad hoc-opgaver, hvor der er brug for en hånd.

Hvem er du?

•       Struktureret, detaljeorienteret og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver

•       Fleksibel, nysgerrig og lærenem

•       God til at tage initiativ og samarbejde på tværs

•       Fortrolig med IT og hurtig til at lære nye systemer

•       God til dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale – vi har leverandører fra hele verden.

Erfaring er ikke et krav – du må meget gerne være nyuddannet. For os handler det om det rigtige mindset.

Vi tilbyder

•       Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for at udvikle dig

•       Indflydelse og korte beslutningsveje i en nystartet virksomhed

•       Afvekslende opgaver – ikke to dage er ens

•       En uformel arbejdsplads, hvor vi arbejder hårdt, men husker at more os

•       En fast fuldtidsstilling med løn efter kvalifikationer.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning om din motivation for netop at søge dette job til Sanne Munk sanne@ren-teq.com. Opstart hurtigst muligt. Vi holder løbende samtaler, og stillingen lukker, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Principal Strategic Sourcing Lead - Technology
Engineering Manager, Security (Cloud, Infrastructure & Application Security)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We are looking for an Engineering Manager, Security to lead the teams that secure our cloud, our infrastructure, and the code we ship. You will manage two closely linked groups:

 - Cloud & Infrastructure Security: engineers who own cloud security posture, configuration hardening, and infrastructure vulnerability management across GCP, AWS, and Azure, plus containers, Kubernetes, and SaaS platforms.

 - Application Security & Secure SDLC: engineers who run our SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs, drive remediation with engineering teams, and deliver secure development training.

The core responsibility of this role is getting vulnerabilities fixed on time. You will partner with engineering teams across the company to drive remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and code findings within SLA, so that we consistently meet our compliance commitments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and customer contracts). You will hire and grow a high-performing team, set the strategy and roadmap for vulnerability management from code to cloud, and make secure-by-default the easiest path for every developer. You will not run incident response yourself, but you need to understand it well enough to support the incident response team with context, prioritization, and follow-up fixes.

 

What You'll Do:


TEAM LEADERSHIP & STRATEGY

 - Build, lead, and mentor a team of cloud security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and application security engineers; own hiring, career development, and performance management.

 - Define the multi-year roadmap and quarterly OKRs for cloud security, vulnerability management, and Secure SDLC, balancing risk reduction against developer velocity.

 - Set clear ownership, operating rhythms, and on-call/escalation processes across the team.

 - Report on security posture, risk trends, and program metrics to engineering and executive leadership.


REMEDIATION & COMPLIANCE DELIVERY

 - Own remediation SLAs by severity across cloud, infrastructure, container, and code findings, and make sure they map to our compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, customer contracts).

 - Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to plan, prioritize, and land fixes within SLA without stalling roadmaps.

 - Run a regular remediation review with engineering leadership: open findings, SLA burn-down, upcoming SLA breaches, and owners.

 - Manage the exception and risk-acceptance process: documented justification, compensating controls, expiry dates, and approvals.

 - Build automated workflows that route findings to the right owning team, track them to closure, and escalate before SLAs are breached.

 - Work with Compliance/GRC to produce audit-ready evidence of remediation timeliness, and lead the security side of external audits for vulnerability management controls.

 - Track and report metrics such as SLA attainment, mean time to remediate, backlog age, and exceptions, by team and severity.


CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud workloads, containers, registries, data stores, and platform services, from scanning and contextual risk triage to remediation workflows.

 - Oversee configuration hardening and secure baselines across GCP (primary) and supporting AWS and Azure environments.

 - Own the strategy for Cloud, Kubernetes, and Data Security Posture Management (CSPM, KSPM, DSPM) tooling; make sure findings are accurate, prioritized, and actionable.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms with sound configurations, access controls, and integrations.

 - Partner with Platform and ML Infrastructure teams to secure multi-tenant and AI infrastructure.


APPLICATION SECURITY & CODE SCANNING

 - Own the SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs end to end: tool selection, CI/CD integration, rule tuning, noise reduction, and developer experience.

 - Drive software supply chain security, including dependency management, SBOMs, artifact signing, and progress through SLSA levels.

 - Feed code-scanning findings into the central remediation workflow so they reach the owning team automatically and are tracked against SLA.

 - Shift IaC security left so misconfigurations are caught in pull requests, before they reach production.


SECURE SDLC & DEVELOPER ENABLEMENT

 - Define and run the Secure SDLC program: security requirements, threat modeling, secure design reviews, and release gates proportionate to risk.

 - Build and deliver security training, including onboarding, role-based secure coding training, and targeted sessions driven by real vulnerability trends.

 - Develop paved roads, secure defaults, and guardrails that make the secure path the easiest path for engineers.

 - Grow a Security Champions network across engineering teams.


INCIDENT RESPONSE PARTNERSHIP & COLLABORATION

 - Understand the incident response lifecycle well enough to support the IR team: supply asset, exposure, and vulnerability context, and help assess blast radius.

 - Own follow-up remediation from incidents and postmortems that touch cloud, infrastructure, or code, and track it to closure.

 - Feed incident learnings back into scanning rules, secure baselines, and developer training.

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring/Detection, Incident Response, Offensive Security, PSIRT, Architecture, DevOps, and Platform Engineering.

 - Help communicate security advisories, best practices, and updates to customers.

 - Tune into threat intelligence alerts to promptly manage patching of critical, exploitable vulnerabilities.

 

Required Skills & Experience:

 - 8+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or DevSecOps, including 2+ years managing security engineers (or 3+ years as a tech lead with formal people-leadership responsibility).

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of cloud security in GCP plus working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure: IAM, networking, logging, org policies, and security services.

 - Proven track record running vulnerability management programs at scale and driving remediation across many engineering teams to meet SLAs, across cloud infrastructure, containers, and application code.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, Lacework, GCP Security Command Center).

 - Hands-on experience with SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Semgrep, CodeQL, Checkmarx, Socket, Dependabot, Checkov, tfsec) and integrating them into CI/CD.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar).

 - Proven track record of building or maturing a Secure SDLC program, including developer security training.

 - Ability to write and review code or automation (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar).

 - Strong understanding of how remediation SLAs and security controls map to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CIS, NIST), and experience producing audit evidence.

 - Working understanding of security incident response in cloud-native environments, enough to partner effectively with IR and detection teams.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain risk in business terms.



Bonus Qualifications:

 - Experience securing developer platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, or AI/ML infrastructure.

 - Experience with software supply chain frameworks (SLSA, Sigstore, SBOM standards).

 - Experience building a Security Champions program or developer-facing security tooling.

 - Experience leading the security side of external audits (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or FedRAMP).

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., CCSP, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, CSSLP), though not required.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: SOC Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We are looking for a SOC Engineer to join our Security Operations team and help defend a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. In this role, your primary mandate will be building and evolving our security data lake, engineering reliable security telemetry, and owning high-fidelity detection engineering end-to-end. You will unify cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry, staying on top of emerging threats to rapidly build and tune detections across our environment. Alongside this data and detection mandate, you will support incident investigations as needed to translate real-world threats into stronger automated defenses. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical depth, understanding of modern software engineering and CI/CD systems, familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (especially GCP), and expertise in security data pipelines and detection workflows.



What You'll Do:

 - Security Data Lake & Detection Engineering: Architect, expand, and maintain our security data lake while designing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and minimize noise across our cloud-native stack.

 - Threat Awareness & Rapid Assessment: Continuously monitor emerging threats (0-days, bad actor activity, public exploitation campaigns, bug bounty reports, customer security issues) and rapidly assess their applicability to Replit's infrastructure, SaaS services, internal tools, and platform components.

 - Investigation & Impact Analysis: Conduct targeted investigations to determine impact, analyze logs, telemetry, and system behaviors using SIEM, metrics, and Cloud Logging and identify gaps in detection/visibility.



Required Skills & Experience:

 - Building and evolving the security data lake, unifying cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry; hands-on experience with SIEM, Cloud Logging, and log-based investigation workflows.

 - Engineering reliable security infrastructure and automation using infrastructure-as-code to close visibility gaps and perform log-based investigations.

 - Proven expertise in detection engineering end-to-end, specifically developing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and reduce noise across complex environments.

 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals (code structure, build systems, dependencies, package ecosystems).

 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services in modern cloud-native deployments.

 - Familiarity with SaaS architectures, identity systems, and integration patterns.



Bonus Qualifications:

 - Experience with threat intelligence, security research, or vulnerability analysis.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, serverless infrastructure, or modern distributed systems.

 - Ability to write scripts or small tools for investigation or automation (Python, Go, Bash).

 - Experience working with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure workflows.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

jobs.description:

Juhid 35-liikmelist meeskonda: osaled töötajate värbamises, juhendad ja koolitad töötajaid, koostad töögraafikuid ning korraldad asendusi. Kontrollid isiklikult objektidel töö kvaliteeti ja ohutusnõuete järgimist, selgitad välja puuduste põhjused ning tagad nende kõrvaldamise. Arvutad Excelis tööajanorme, töömahte, personali- ja materjalivajadust ning teenuste omahinda ja maksumust. Analüüsid kulusid ja ressursside kasutamise tõhusust. Suhtled klientidega, koostad ja põhjendad hinnapakkumisi, lepid kokku töökorralduslikke muudatusi ning lahendad igapäevaseid küsimusi ja pretensioone. Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Muud nõuded: Kehtiv Puhastustööde juht, tase 5 kutsetunnistus. Puhastustööde korraldamise ja meeskonna juhtimise kogemus, vähemalt 3 aastat. Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.


You will:

 - Set technical direction for Replit’s financial infrastructure, with an immediate focus on enterprise billing, spend controls, and financial correctness.

 - Build shared services for usage-based billing, pricing, credits, subscriptions, and entitlements so product teams can launch without rebuilding billing.

 - Automate enterprise contract lifecycles—from onboarding through amendments and renewals—keeping commercial terms, provisioned credits, and invoices in sync.

 - Build timely budget enforcement, alerts, and overrides that give customers control over spend without disrupting their hosted apps.

 - Make AI usage understandable: attribute costs to the right customer, workspace, user, or agent, including delegated work without double-counting.

 - Build reconciliation and audit trails that make balances and invoices explainable and help Finance catch discrepancies before customers do.

 - Simplify the billing stack through safe migrations that preserve balances, transaction history, and customer access.

 - Own production reliability through testing, observability, incident response, and safe recovery from duplicate events, delayed usage, and partial failures.

 - Stay hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Support.


Required skills and experience:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical ownership: setting architecture and delivering complex initiatives across teams.

 - Deep experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, databases, and event-driven architecture.

 - Sound judgment around transactions, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

 - Experience evolving live systems and migrating data without compromising correctness or availability.

 - Product judgment that balances customer needs, delivery speed, and long-term system quality.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, including translating business requirements into system behavior.

 - Hands-on leadership through implementation, design reviews, mentoring, and production ownership.


Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, credits, entitlements, or other financial systems.

 - Experience with enterprise contracts, negotiated pricing, invoicing, or quote-to-cash automation.

 - Experience with high-volume usage metering, pricing calculations, or low-latency spend controls.

 - Experience building reconciliation, financial reporting, or auditable transaction histories with Finance and Accounting.

 - Experience integrating billing, payment, or CRM platforms, with judgment about what to build versus buy.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with AI or cloud infrastructure billing, including variable costs and attribution across distributed workloads.

 - Experience building customer-facing spend visibility, budgets, or internal tools that reduce manual billing work.

 - Experience with cloud marketplace billing, payment recovery, or fraud and dispute workflows.

 - Familiarity with agentic commerce or delegated spending. These are additional strengths, not requirements.



What we value:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements.

 - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout.

 - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions.

 - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients.

 - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.

 - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness.

 - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck.

 - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams.

 - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically.

Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Core Requirements

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 9, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment termsAppointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.
